card.name: Right before contain/containing
card.fires_on: The last word or piece before a form of "contain", such as a product or drug name, "capsules", or the start of "Containing". It is seen in label text about ingredients.

modes.label: Product name or noun before contains
modes.description: A drug name or product noun that is the subject of the verb contain.
modes.example: This<< product>> contains FD&C Yellow No. 5

modes.label: Split "Containing"
modes.description: The first piece of a split "Containing" or "CONTAINING" in headings.

modes.label: Last piece of brand name
modes.description: The end of a brand name just before "contains" or "contain".

card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to say that a product contains an ingredient.
